zh-CN.name: 标书联合审查
zh-CN.summary: 五角色协作审查条款响应、商务报价和标书图片，并独立复核证据。
zh-CN.description: 成果质量导向的五角色标书辅助审查：用自然语言说明目标和材料，成员自主检查，总审按重要问题、依据、整改建议和未决事项验收。结构化导出为可选能力，结果需人工复核；真实标书效果尚未验证。成员默认收纳在组长下方并初始收起；用户显式选择平铺或收纳时，以用户选择为准。

en-US.name: Tender Review Team
en-US.summary: Five roles review requirements, pricing and tender images with independent evidence checks.
en-US.description: Five roles assist with tender review focused on output quality. Describe the goals and materials in natural language; members perform their checks independently, and the lead reviews important issues, supporting evidence, corrective recommendations, and unresolved items. Structured export is optional; human review is required and effectiveness on real tender documents has not yet been verified. Members initially appear collapsed under the supervisor; an explicit user choice of flat or nested display takes precedence.

requirements.value: Requires DesireCore 10.0.178 or newer with support for team.json memberDisplay. Stable 10.0.177 does not support this manifest field. This catalog release is published ahead of the compatible client; older clients must upgrade before installation. Full cross-platform release qualification remains pending.
